description: Own a rare 6.2-hectare titled beachfront property in the world-renowned destination of El Nido, Palawan. Boasting approximately 121 meters of pristine white sand beachfront, this exceptional property offers breathtaking ocean views, crystal-clear waters, and a tranquil atmosphere perfect for those seeking privacy and natural beauty.

Located just 41 minutes from El Nido Town, the property is ideal for a luxury beach resort, eco-tourism development, private estate, vacation retreat, or long-term investment. The beach is also known as a surfing spot, making it attractive to water sports enthusiasts and adventure travelers.

While the area is currently off-grid, mobile network coverage is available, and electricity can be conveniently supplied through solar power or a generator, making it well-suited for sustainable developments. With a competitive asking price of ₱5,000 per square meter (negotiable) and a clean titled ownership, this beachfront property presents an excellent opportunity to invest in one of the Philippines' most sought-after island destinations.
